definition: The process of generating invoices, processing payments, and managing subscription charges for products or services.
extendedDefinition: Billing covers the generation of invoices, processing of payments, and management of charges for services and subscriptions, forming the money-moving core of any commercial software operation. For SaaS products, billing must handle recurring cycles, proration, upgrades, downgrades, and renewals without surprising customers. Buyers should examine billing transparency during evaluation: are pricing tiers clear, are overages and usage-based charges predictable, and is the invoice accurate against the contract? Billing errors erode trust quickly and generate support volume out of proportion to their size. Strong billing systems integrate with accounting platforms, payment gateways, and tax engines so that finance teams see consistent records. Organizations choosing software with complex consumption models should model worst-case usage in advance, because the cheapest base tier rarely reflects realistic month-to-month cost.
